setupSaveBehavior.emptySavePreviewExample: Online validation stops in the editor before saveOnline/saveDraft; highlighted required fields and Cancel can be tested without local draft writes
setupSaveBehavior.dirtyCancel: Asks Discard unsaved changes?; Discard changes drops only the unsaved form
setupSaveBehavior.validSavePreviewExample: Valid saveOnline first encrypts/persists a local draft. With Preview null gateway, it inserts a published example only into in-memory state, then deletes that draft. The local secure key/database files can remain. This is not a zero-disk operation.
setupSaveBehavior.publishedExampleRetention: Refresh or re-fetch regenerates Preview samples; the added published example disappears. No server confirmation or financial posting occurs.
setupSaveBehavior.saveDraft: Writes a local encrypted draft and returns Encrypted draft saved on this device. It does not publish the Preview example.
setupSaveBehavior.visibleSetupDraftRecoveryAfterRestart: Not established. Current setup screen/controller show no draft-list or resume path; a save toast, directory presence or controlled memory test cannot prove ordinary-user recovery.
setupSaveBehavior.preferenceRestart: Theme/density persistence can be checked through the actual verified Preview UI after restarting the same executable, independently of accounting draft recovery.
